lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately twelve visible vertical columns across the lateral mid-body.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal lines of spots to create a grid-like configuration.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges with sharp vertical luminance gradients visible on the upper and mid-flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance spots contained within the macro-mask of the dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three remoras visible beneath the ventral silhouette and the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
